name: AMN-AI narration
description: How the studio's narrators say names and acronyms (2026-10-12, the Owner's yes). Numbers and units need no rule: ElevenLabs' text normalisation already says them right.
note: Phoneme rules work on eleven_flash_v2 (the studio's narration model); a model that cannot read them skips them silently, aliases work on every model. Matching is case-sensitive and on whole words. Evidence for each rule is in its 'why'.

rules.why: Rolf Widerøe (cyclotron film aa170155, scene 2): the vendor's normalised alignment turned it into «Wideroe».
The same name written without ø.
François Englert (Higgs film 1c038a99, scene 4): Belgian, not «ENG-lert».
Said as one word, never spelled (films babcf272, 1c038a99, 63e3da7c).
The detector's name, said as a word (Lyra flagged it on 63e3da7c).
Lyra flagged «125 GeV» (63e3da7c); said in full for a general audience.
The LHC's energies, the same way as GeV.
The cyclotron's energies, the same way as GeV.
Comet NEOWISE, in two verified scripts not yet made: one word, not spelled.
